facts.fact: Decree (décret) no. 2020-209 of 18 March 2020, issued by the Presidency, sets up the XRoad BJ national interoperability platform; the document describes it as the founding instrument of the platform and states nothing on whether it obliges public bodies to use it.

note: Held text is a stub: the PDF is an unreadable scan, so only the decree's existence, number, date and purpose are stated; no duty or application fact.
